name: app-green-duotone-hands-super-app-close-up
title: Green Duotone Hands with Super-App Home
whatItIs: A phone held in two hands, a finger about to tap, all rendered in a green duotone glow on a dark green gradient, showing a super-app home screen with a city illustration, wallet balance and service icons.
whatItMeans: Tinting the hands and backdrop in one green makes the colorful UI the only full-color element, so the screen glows. The touching finger adds anticipation.
techniques: Duotone treatment for photographic hands so the UI is the sole colour source
Finger approaching a target for narrative tension
Dark radial gradient with subtle dot texture
Illustrated header art inside the app for character
bestFor: Hero shots that focus attention on the interface

vocabulary.definition: An image rendered in two tones or one hue range.
A frame capturing a finger about to interact.
A grid of icons each opening a different service.
